Rules: READ-ONLY: list/show/query verbs only. Never create, update, delete, set, assign, deploy or run `az login`/`az account set`/`az logout`.
Subscriptions on this machine: `Example Product - NonProd` (default) and `Example Tooling`. Always pass `--subscription "<name or id>"` explicitly; check with `az account list -o table` first.

Always use `--output json` plus `--query` (JMESPath) or jq to keep output small; never print keys, connection strings or secrets (do not use `az keyvault secret show` unless the prompt explicitly asks for a named secret and says how to handle it).

CliTools.Name: az
CliTools.UseCase: Azure CLI. Example: `az resource list --subscription "Example Product - NonProd" --output json --query "[].{n:name,t:type}"`.
